annotations.title: Base token batch (10 tokens + DEX price)

description: [PAID $0.01 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Batch version of /api/base/token for Base mainnet (chain 8453): pass up to 10 comma-separated contract addresses in `addresses` and get, per token, contract/EOA check, ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals/totalSupply, proxy implementation, owner() and renounced flag, well-known flag, and `market` from DexScreener (USD price, total liquidity, 24h volume/change, FDV, top pair; market=0 to skip). A bad token yields a per-item error instead of failing the call. Fixed $0.01 per call (vs $0.002 x 10). Metadata cached 1 h, market 60 s. Defaults to USDC, WETH, AERO. Invalid input = 400, never charged.

addresses.description: Comma-separated Base token addresses (max 10). Optional: defaults to USDC, WETH, AERO.
